# Network Resilience Experiment Report

This report is generated from versioned evidence. It keeps measured containerlab observations separate from deterministic topology analysis.

## Executive summary

- Compared OSPF-only and BFD failure detection across **20 trials per profile**.
- Reduced the p95 detection upper bound by **87.21%** with BFD 100 ms × 3.
- Reduced p95 packets lost before observable failover from **37** to **3**.
- Found **1** declared shared-risk outage scenario in candidate `service-dual-homed`.

## Evidence classification

| Evidence | Classification | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Single-run OSPF/BFD comparison | Measured in containerlab | One controlled carrier-up blackhole observation per profile |
| Repeated OSPF/BFD trials | Measured in containerlab | Distribution across 20 sequential observations per profile |
| SRLG audit | Modeled from declared failure domains | Deterministic reachability and path-cost calculation |

## Repeated detection experiment

| Profile | p50 upper bound | p95 upper bound | Maximum upper bound |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OSPF only | 3,794.5 ms | 4,058 ms | 4,158 ms |
| BFD 100 ms × 3 | 498 ms | 519 ms | 523 ms |

The 100 ms probe interval makes these values observation upper bounds, not protocol-internal processing times.

## Single-run path transition

| Profile | Detection upper bound | Lost packets before failover | OSPF metric |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OSPF only | 3,384 ms | 31 | 30 → 140 |
| BFD 100 ms × 3 | 336 ms | 2 | 30 → 140 |

Both runs started on metric `30` and converged to the intended backup path at metric `140` after the same remote packet blackhole was injected.

## Shared-risk audit

| Failure domain | Type | Impact | Affected access nodes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `primary-site-power` | power_domain | DEGRADED | access1 |
| `service-entry` | shared_conduit | OUTAGE | access1, access2 |

Passing link or node N-1 does not establish physical path independence. The `service-entry` result demonstrates the remaining common-risk boundary.

## Interpretation boundaries

- The fault is emulated with tc netem in local Linux namespaces.
- Event markers precede tc commands, so observed bounds include command overhead.
- Trials run sequentially in one local containerlab deployment.
- The 100 ms probe interval makes detection values upper bounds.
- The SRLG section is deterministic graph analysis over declared failure domains; it is not a physical route-diversity survey.
- Results apply to this local lab topology and configuration; they are not a production SLA.
